prompt: Compose one complete original instrumental game score lasting exactly 150 seconds, not a short loop repeated. No voices, lyrics, spoken words or sampled speech. Keep clear space for game sound effects and avoid crash sounds or victory endings. Arcade rooftop drum and bass at 168 BPM: nimble breakbeats, rubbery bass, bright parkour plucks, quick call-and-response leads and train-track percussion.
